summary.intent: Resolve all automated PR review comments from GitHub Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then investigate why the release gate did not block merging until E2E tests completed.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments were fixed, committed, and resolved. The root cause of the release gate issue was identified (stale green checks on the release-please PR after a `test:` commit merged to main), but the fix was in progress (adding a post-E2E job to re-trigger the release gate on open release-please PRs) and not yet merged.

repo: CodeRabbit has per-repo review quotas with ~23-minute cooldowns between review rounds.
The release gate (`release-gate.yml`) auto-passes with 'Not a release PR' for non-release PRs, making it meaningless as a blocking check for feature/test PRs.
E2E workflow only triggers on push to main, not on PRs — so tests only run after merge.
`test:` commit type does not trigger release-please to update its PR, so the release gate can have stale green checks when test-only changes land on main.
Committed fixture files live in `tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/` and must not be overwritten or deleted by test utility functions.
The `vars` context is automatically available in reusable workflows called via `workflow_call`.
Phase 34 was e2e-test-expansion-staging-baselines, adding batch-download, media-preview, and streaming-playback specs plus cleanup helpers and load test baselines.

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, and createTestBinaryFile all needed a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard to prevent test cleanup from deleting committed fixture files when the caller passes a name matching an existing fixture.
Missing `faro_enabled: true` metadata field that the plan spec required.
page.evaluate() in teardown needed a page.isClosed() guard to avoid errors when the page was already closed before cleanup ran.
A new job was being added to re-trigger the release gate on open release-please PRs after E2E completes on main, to prevent stale green checks from allowing premature release merges.
The 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable' skip path is the root cause of the release gate not blocking non-release PRs.

workflow: When polling for external events (bot reviews), background tasks with sleep+check are effective but generate many stale task notifications that pile up.
Copilot reviews typically arrive within ~10 minutes; CodeRabbit has quota limits that can delay reviews by 20+ minutes.
Replying to review comments requires REST API comment IDs (integers), while resolving threads requires GraphQL thread IDs — these are different and require separate lookups.
Investigating CI gate failures requires checking both the trigger conditions AND the pass/skip logic of required checks — a check can be 'required' but always pass via a skip path.

friction: CodeRabbit quota cooldown (~23 min) caused extensive polling loops with many redundant background tasks.
Background polling created a large number of completed task notifications that cluttered the conversation.

The initial diagnosis of the release gate issue was wrong twice — first proposed adding PR triggers to e2e.yml, then proposed gating feature PRs, before identifying the actual root cause (stale checks on release-please PR after test: commits).
REST vs GraphQL API distinction for PR review comment reply vs thread resolution required extra lookup steps to find correct IDs.
open_items: PR adding post-E2E re-trigger job to e2e.yml was committed but not yet merged or reviewed.
The incorrectly scoped PR #393 (adding E2E gate for feature PRs) was closed but the underlying question of whether feature PRs should also require E2E is unresolved.
